description: This is a shell script responsible for handling crash and minidump files: collecting, compressing, timestamping, and uploading them to a crash portal or S3. It manages various configurations, locks, rate-limiting, and error handling to ensure reliable crash reporting in a device environment.

methods.name: getOptOutStatus
methods.description: Checks whether telemetry opt-out is enabled via RFC feature and local file.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Sets the log filename based on given parameters, avoiding duplicate processing.

methods.name: logStdout
methods.description: Logs standard output lines to the main log.

methods.name: create_lock_or_exit
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or exits if lock exists.

methods.name: create_lock_or_wait
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or waits until it can.

methods.name: remove_lock
methods.description: Removes a lock directory.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs formatted message to the log file with timestamp and process id.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS specific errors.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes filenames and parameters for safety in shell commands.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct upload is blocked based on last failure timestamp.

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if codebig upload is blocked based on last failure timestamp.

methods.name: checkParameter
methods.description: Checks if key parameters are set and assigns default values if empty.

methods.name: checkMAC
methods.description: Ensures MAC address is available and formatted properly.

methods.name: deleteAllButTheMostRecentFile
methods.description: Deletes older dump files exceeding the max limit, keeping only the most recent.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up old or unfinished dump files and associated logs.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup, releases locks, and marks reboot if needed.

methods.name: sigkill_function
methods.description: Handles SIGKILL signal to cleanup locks.

methods.name: sigterm_function
methods.description: Handles SIGTERM signal to cleanup locks.

methods.name: logUploadTimestamp
methods.description: Records upload timestamp for rate limiting.

methods.name: truncateTimeStampFile
methods.description: Keeps only latest 10 timestamps to limit crash rate tracking.

methods.name: isUploadLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if crash upload rate exceeds threshold within time window.

methods.name: setRecoveryTime
methods.description: Sets a recovery timestamp to delay further uploads.

methods.name: isRecoveryTimeReached
methods.description: Checks if recovery delay has passed.

methods.name: removePendingDumps
methods.description: Deletes queued dump files when rate limits or blacklisting occurs.

methods.name: markAsCrashLoopedAndUpload
methods.description: Renames crash dump to crashloop format and triggers upload to crash portal.

methods.name: downloadBlacklist
methods.description: Fetches the blacklist list from S3 if outdated.

methods.name: isBuildBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if current build matches blacklist entries for exclusion.

methods.name: uploadToS3
methods.description: Handles signing and uploading dump files to Amazon S3 via signed URLs, optionally using MTLS security.

methods.name: processDumps
methods.description: Processes dump files: compresses, encrypts, uploads, and cleans up.
